notes: Save is now two steps: the click only issues chrome.storage.local.get (if not fresh); the decision (gate vs commit), the read of the form and the update of `current` happen in the callback (popup.js:103-113). Between the two the view is unchanged and nothing prevents another Save click.

gate() does not clear an existing interval and can be entered from the callback in any state (popup.js:67-75). Reaching it in G2 needs a second Save callback arriving after the user already pressed stage-1 yes (>600 ms late) - implausible with chrome.storage but not excluded by the code.

The gate message is written once in gate() and not touched in stage 2/3, so its height is constant; only the one-line title and the button label change. With class 'last' the yes button (1px border, so 2px taller) is ordered before 'Keep blocking'; the spot of the former yes button is covered by 'Keep blocking' except a 2px strip at its top that falls in the margin between the buttons (popup.html:16,22-26). Derived from the CSS, not rendered.
fresh(): 600 ms after show('form'), show('gate') and stage-3 appearance; affects Save, 'Keep blocking' and both yes handlers only. Not reset on G1->G2. Not active on first opening (shownAt=-1e9).
The wait uses performance.now(). Behaviour across device sleep, and whether a popup can be hidden without being destroyed, is browser-dependent.
commit() only updates `current` and shows 'Saved' if chrome.runtime.lastError is unset; on failure nothing is shown at all (popup.js:39).
If either storage.get callback receives undefined (storage error) `r.settings` throws: Save stays disabled (load) or the click silently does nothing (Save) (popup.js:9-13,106-107).
Hidden controls are display:none and unreachable; stale handlers stay attached.

The allowed video then stays hidden under the sibling's cover (content.css:1), and its own snapshot's boxPosition is dropped.

The 'can't open' flag is set on the overlay and never removed: block() returns before writing the normal message for as long as that overlay node lives, even after a record arrives and the button would work (content.js:144,149). Only removal of the overlay (unblock or sweep) clears it.

Overlay listeners are bubble-phase for click, pointerdown/up, touchstart/end, mousedown/up; preventDefault only on click. Capture-phase page listeners, keydown, dblclick, auxclick, contextmenu, wheel are not intercepted (content.js:131-135).
The guard does not unblock and cannot see detached elements (content.js:231-242).

cross_component.description: Popup commit writes 'settings'; every X tab's content script gets storage.onChanged, updates its mirror and schedules a scan (via setTimeout when that tab is hidden and no frame is pending).
Save reads 'settings' from storage before deciding, so changes written by another popup instance are taken into account at that moment (not afterwards during the gate).
Any chrome.storage.local change triggers schedule() in every X tab.
inject.js 'xvg:media' -> content.js caches -> scan; later records overwrite byThumb/byMedia but not byTweet.
'Play in new tab' -> xvg:open -> background cleanup + payload/player tab, or allowOnce + status tab. One accepted open per 1.5 s per overlay.
allowOnce applies in every tab on /status/<id> for 15 minutes; a second fallback open overwrites it and re-blocks the first tab at its next scan/media event.
Player reads xvg_p_<id> once; cleanup (startup, install, every open) removes keys older than 24 h.
Removing a blocked <video> makes the next scan remove its overlay if the box has no other video.
SPA navigation: 500 ms pathname poll schedules a scan.

NEW: the hidden-tab scan path is skipped whenever an animation-frame scan is already pending at the moment the tab is hidden. schedule() checks `pending` before `document.hidden`; the frozen frame keeps pending=true, so every later schedule() returns early and no scan or sweep runs until the tab is visible again. X mutates constantly, so a pending frame at tab-switch time is likely. (Whether a browser flushes requested frames on hide is browser behaviour.)

NEW: the 'can't open' note is permanent for the life of the overlay: data-xvg-note is never removed, block() returns before writing the normal message, so after a record arrives the overlay still says it can't be opened (the button then works) and never names the author. A replacement <video> in the same box inherits it.

NEW: Save is asynchronous and gate() neither checks the current state nor clears a running interval. Two overlapping Save reads call gate() twice; if the second callback landed after the stage-1 yes, the old interval would keep running under a rebuilt stage-1 UI, and after a new stage-1 click the orphaned tick would reset shownAt every 250 ms forever (all buttons permanently ignored). Needs a storage callback more than 600 ms late - implausible, but nothing in the code rules it out.
NEW: the form is read in the callback, not at the click (edits made in between are saved), and a non-loosening double click issues two reads and two writes.

NEW: storage is re-read only at Save. A `next` already inside the gate is committed 15 s later as captured, overwriting whatever another context stored meanwhile (handles removed elsewhere during the wait come back without being named in the gate message).
NEW: a failed write is silent: after 'Yes, do it' the form is shown with the unsaved values and neither 'Saved' nor an error appears.

NEW: in a shared box the early return in unblock() also skips restoring the box position and drops that video's snapshot; inline 'relative' can remain after all videos are allowed. The allowed video stays invisible while a sibling is blocked.
NEW: hidden-tab scans use setTimeout(0) per mutation batch (no frame coalescing); cost is bounded only by the browser's background timer throttling.
